description: Ground truth for the held-out set (fixtures/witness-heldout). Written together with the cases and fixed BEFORE any author run, and never edited after seeing author output. Same schema as author-truth.json. These cases were authored after, and deliberately differ from, the findings v2's prompt rule was tuned on: they cover TRUE ctx/contract bugs (to measure false refutation), a package double that itself violates the contract, other contract and error-path traps (non-ctx), and plain true/false/opinion findings. Reference witnesses were executed through the real pipeline to check each label (see tests/witnessHeldout.test.ts and `testbed.ts --heldout`).

go-ctx-retry-true.why: Head retries on every error including ctx.Err(); base returned on any error other than ErrNotReady. A ctx-honouring Source (the package FakeSource) shows 4 calls vs 1.

go-ctx-package-double-loose.why: Store documents that implementations MUST honour ctx, so with any compliant Store a cancelled ctx stops Save after the first Put. Only the package MemStore (documented as non-compliant) shows 2 calls.

go-contract-sorted-false.why: Lister documents ascending order, which Merge relies on. With any compliant Lister (the package StaticLister) the output is ascending. Only a Lister that violates its contract yields out-of-order output.

go-memo-error-path-false.why: For a successful load, load runs once per key (second Get is served from the map). Only a FAILING load runs twice, which the doc comment says is intended (errors are not cached).

go-window-offbyone-true.why: Head slices from len-n-1; base sliced from len-n.

go-tally-nilmap-true.why: The map is declared but never made, on base and on head, so any non-empty input panics.

go-median-new-true.why: File is new in the PR; the even-length branch returns the lower middle, contradicting its own doc comment.

go-cents-round-false.why: Uses math.Round; 0.29*100 is 28.999999999999996 and rounds to 29.

go-sorted-copy-false.why: Sorts a copy made with append([]int(nil), xs...).

go-flush-after-error-true.why: Head flushes inside the error branch; base returned the error without flushing. The package RecordingWriter honours the Writer contract.

js-chunk-partial-true.why: Head loop condition i + size <= length skips the last short group; base used i < length.
